blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo on Monday clarified that she has no intention of leaving the Catholic Church after a photo of her wearing Masonic regalia during a recent gathering circulated on social media, drawing questions about her faith. In a Facebook post, Robredo said she maintains good relations with non-Catholic churches
